headline: Steelers traded Joey Porter Jr. to the Cowboys
detail: Dallas sent a 2028 second-round pick and a 2027 sixth-round pick. Porter was already ruled out for Pittsburgh's Thursday game at Cleveland.
desk: Do not count Porter as a Steelers corner. Do not count him as an active Cowboy until the Dallas feed lists him.

headline: Calvin Austin III torn ACL, out for 2026
detail: Austin is not on the 2026 target chart. He caught the division-clinching touchdown in January, then tore his ACL and will miss the season.
desk: Do not chart Austin targets. He is not a Steelers receiver this year.

headline: Steelers released Jonnu Smith
detail: Pittsburgh released Smith on March 5. Freiermuth and Washington are the tight ends still under contract.
desk: Do not chart Smith targets. He is not on the Steelers.
